nodes.name: ui-upgrade.md
nodes.summary: Project plan document for refactoring the monolithic App.svelte component, with file-size stats, roadmap phases (extract modals, CSS cleanup, Svelte 5 runes migration), and reference to DamageAnalyzer.svelte being left mostly alone.

nodes.name: extensions.json
nodes.summary: VS Code workspace extension recommendations — only recommends svelte.svelte-vscode.

nodes.name: app.css
nodes.summary: Global CSS with :root design tokens for colors, surfaces, borders, accent palette, fonts, transitions, radii; theme-specific overrides for Draconic, Caustic Slow, Stance Change, TagFilter, and Others tab accent colors.
nodes.languageNotes: Tailwind CSS v4 global stylesheet with CSS custom properties

nodes.name: App.svelte
nodes.summary: Main application component (~4431 lines). Weapon builder with drag-and-drop armor/ring slots, grid-based drag for weapon parts, corruption management, CDR perk toggling, inline enchant editor with swap mode, modal system (race/guild/armor/weapon selection) with fuzzy search, stat/tag filtering, armor sort modes (Highest/Most Effective/Brawny), draconic ability selector, undo/clear, suggestions dropdown, enchant tooltips, and detail cards for each slot.
nodes.languageNotes: Svelte 5 with $: reactive statements; script ~1264 lines, template ~1860 lines, CSS ~1332 lines

nodes.name: onArmorDragStart
nodes.summary: Sets draggingArmorSlot and optionally dragMode from DragEvent dataTransfer to initiate armor piece drag.

nodes.name: onArmorDragOver
nodes.summary: Sets dragOverArmorSlot if slot is a valid target; prevents default to allow drop.

nodes.name: onArmorDrop
nodes.summary: Completes armor drag: moves piece between slots (helmet/chestplate/leggings/infusion variants).

nodes.name: onArmorTap
nodes.summary: Selects or deselects an armor slot; opens modal if it's the first tap on that slot.

nodes.name: onRingDragStart
nodes.summary: Sets draggingRing to the target ring slot to initiate ring drag.

nodes.name: onRingDrop
nodes.summary: Completes ring drag: swaps ring/infusionRing positions via moveRingSlot store action.

nodes.name: onRingTap
nodes.summary: Selects a ring slot or opens ring modal on second tap.

nodes.name: handleGridMouseDown
nodes.summary: Initiates grid-based drag for weapon parts (blade/handle/glove/essence) from a slot.

nodes.name: onGridMouseMove
nodes.summary: Handles mouse move during grid drag: updates ghost position, performs hit-testing for valid targets, shows action badge.

nodes.name: onGridMouseUp
nodes.summary: Completes grid drag: executes the action (set/move/swap/clone) between grid slots.

nodes.name: toggleCdrPerk
nodes.summary: Toggles a CDR perk on/off in the build store by modifying the cdPerks set.

nodes.name: computeArmorEffectiveBoost
nodes.summary: Computes effective boost of an armor piece by iterating weapon scalings × armor's stat value for each scaling key.

nodes.name: computeArmorBrawnyEffectiveBoost
nodes.summary: Computes effective boost with Brawny conversion: converts Brawny armor stat to strength then applies weapon scalings.

nodes.name: switchTab
nodes.summary: Switches between 'overview' and 'analyze' tabs.

nodes.name: handleClearBuild
nodes.summary: Resets the entire build to defaults via clearBuild store action.

nodes.name: handleUndo
nodes.summary: Reverts build to previous state from undo history store.

nodes.name: toggleUpgrade
nodes.summary: Toggles upgrade level for a given equipment slot between 0 and UPGRADE_MAX.

nodes.name: adjustStoredCorruption
nodes.summary: Adjusts stored corruption value by a delta, clamped to [0, 100].

nodes.name: openModal
nodes.summary: Opens a modal of the given type and resets search/stat filters.

nodes.name: closeModal
nodes.summary: Closes the active modal and clears search query.

nodes.name: matchSearch
nodes.summary: Fuzzy-matches an item name or its perk names against the current modalSearch query.

nodes.name: toggleInlineEnchant
nodes.summary: Toggles the inline enchant editor open/closed for a given enchant slot.

nodes.name: enterSwapMode
nodes.summary: Enters enchantment swap mode, recording the source slot.

nodes.name: handleSwapClick
nodes.summary: Completes an enchantment swap between source and target slots via swapEnchantments store action.

nodes.name: handleEnchantButtonClick
nodes.summary: Opens the enchant selection modal for a specific slot with proper context.

nodes.name: selectDraconicAbility
nodes.summary: Sets the selected draconic ability in the build store.

nodes.name: cycleDraconicAbility
nodes.summary: Cycles to the next available draconic ability in the list.

nodes.name: toggleEnchantCat
nodes.summary: Toggles the expanded/collapsed state of an enchant category section.

nodes.name: swapEnchantIndices
nodes.summary: Swaps two enchantment positions within a slot's enchantment array.

nodes.name: applyEnchantToAll
nodes.summary: Copies an enchantment from one slot to all other compatible slots.

nodes.name: substringLevenshtein
nodes.summary: Computes a fuzzy substring match score between query and candidate using Levenshtein distance variant.

nodes.name: applySuggestion
nodes.summary: Applies a 'Did you mean?' suggestion by setting the modal search query or filtering by the suggested name/perk.

nodes.name: buildSlotCard
nodes.summary: Builds a detail card object for an equipment slot with stats, perks, and upgrades for the overview panel.

nodes.name: buildEnchantLabel
nodes.summary: Generates a formatted display label for an enchantment slot.

nodes.name: sortByStatFilter
nodes.summary: Sorts armor/weapon items by best stat match, most effective boost, or Brawny effective boost.

nodes.name: weaponMatchesFilter
nodes.summary: Checks if a weapon item matches active tag and stat filters.

nodes.name: getPerkNames
nodes.summary: Extracts perk names from an item's perks/perkName fields into a string array.

nodes.name: BaseDamageCalc.svelte
nodes.summary: Damage computation component (~2732 lines). Computes per-hit pre-mitigation damage, applies boosts/typed-multipliers/armor/debuffs, resolves damage types, calculates effective defenses, handles DoT damage, displays hit tables with crit/raw/heal columns, enemy HP slider, defense presets, and custom defense overrides.

nodes.name: resolveTypeInfo
nodes.summary: Resolves display info, applicable boosts, typed multiplier, debuff mult, defense %, and armor mult for a damage type key.

nodes.name: computePreMitigationBase
nodes.summary: Computes pre-mitigation base damage per type from a hit definition, applying weapon/WA/ability base damage and scaling.

nodes.name: getApplicableBoosts
nodes.summary: Filters and resolves the applicable damage/heal boost multipliers for a given damage type key.

nodes.name: calcActiveDebuffDamageMult
nodes.summary: Computes total damage multiplier from active debuffs (e.g., Exposure, Vulnerability).

nodes.name: calcDebuffTypeDamageMult
nodes.summary: Computes per-type damage multipliers from active debuffs.

nodes.name: calcEffectiveDefenses
nodes.summary: Computes effective defense % per damage type after applying debuffs, penetration, and inheritance.

nodes.name: calcArmorMult
nodes.summary: Calculates armor multiplier from defense% and penetration, with low/high branch threshold for armor pen.

nodes.name: cycleVariant
nodes.summary: Cycles the variant of a damage group (e.g., weapon art variant selection).

nodes.name: loadDefenses
nodes.summary: Loads custom defense values from localStorage.

nodes.name: resetDefenses
nodes.summary: Resets all custom defense values to defaults.

nodes.name: applyPreset
nodes.summary: Applies a named defense preset (e.g., boss values) to all defense fields.

nodes.name: hitTypeSum
nodes.summary: Sums all non-heal type values for a single hit, optionally using crit values.

nodes.name: hitHealSum
nodes.summary: Sums all heal type values for a single hit, optionally using crit values.

nodes.name: groupTotalSum
nodes.summary: Sums total non-heal damage across a group of hits, accounting for count multipliers.

nodes.name: defPctForType
nodes.summary: Looks up the defense % for a given damage type from effectiveDefenses.

nodes.name: crushingPenForType
nodes.summary: Resolves Crushing Pressure penetration value for a given damage type.

nodes.name: BuffList.svelte
nodes.summary: Buff/debuff list component (~849 lines). Displays active buffs from items, perks, potions, weapon arts, and draconic infusion; shows stat changes, custom duration/potency sliders, debuff toggling, warding debuff multiplier, and auto-debuff overlays.

nodes.name: fmtPotency
nodes.summary: Formats a potency value with one decimal place for display.

nodes.name: BuildSaves.svelte
nodes.summary: Build save/load/export/import component (~1288 lines). Supports up to 100 save slots with drag-reordering, fuzzy search across saved builds, base64 compressed export/import, duplicate detection, inline name editing, and localStorage persistence.

nodes.name: buildSearchIndexFromBuilds
nodes.summary: Builds a deduplicated search index of item/perk names from all saved builds for the search dropdown.

nodes.name: fuzzyScore
nodes.summary: Computes a fuzzy match score between a query and a target string using character-by-character matching.

nodes.name: loadSlots
nodes.summary: Loads saved build slots from localStorage.

nodes.name: persistSlots
nodes.summary: Persists build slots to localStorage.

nodes.name: saveBuild
nodes.summary: Saves current build to a slot; creates new slot or overwrites existing.

nodes.name: doSave
nodes.summary: Internal save implementation: encodes state, persists slots, shows toast notification.

nodes.name: loadBuild
nodes.summary: Loads a saved build from a slot into the active build store.

nodes.name: deleteSlot
nodes.summary: Deletes a saved build slot after confirmation.

nodes.name: formatDate
nodes.summary: Formats a timestamp into a locale date string.

nodes.name: getBuildSummary
nodes.summary: Generates a human-readable summary string of a build (race, guild, weapon, armor pieces).

nodes.name: encodeState
nodes.summary: Compresses a BuildState into a base64-encoded string for export, using minification and key mapping.

nodes.name: isDangerousKey
nodes.summary: Checks if an object key is potentially dangerous (e.g., __proto__) for import sanitization.

nodes.name: sanitizeField
nodes.summary: Sanitizes an imported field value to prevent prototype pollution or dangerous values.

nodes.name: copyCode
nodes.summary: Copies the compressed export code for the current build to clipboard.

nodes.name: focusOnMount
nodes.summary: Svelte use:action that focuses an input element when mounted.

nodes.name: startEdit
nodes.summary: Puts a slot into inline edit mode for renaming.

nodes.name: confirmEdit
nodes.summary: Confirms and persists the renamed slot label.

nodes.name: findAllDuplicates
nodes.summary: Finds all slots with the same build state as the given one (for duplicate detection).

nodes.name: startAutoScroll
nodes.summary: Starts auto-scrolling the slot list when dragging near the top/bottom edge.

nodes.name: stopAutoScroll
nodes.summary: Stops the auto-scroll interval.

nodes.name: moveSlot
nodes.summary: Moves a slot from one index to another in the saves array.

nodes.name: handleMouseDown
nodes.summary: Initiates mouse-based drag reordering of save slots.

nodes.name: handleMouseUp
nodes.summary: Completes mouse-based drag reordering of save slots.

nodes.name: CdrStepsCalc.svelte
nodes.summary: CDR step visualization component (~93 lines). Displays cooldown reduction as a chain of operations (set-bonus override, perk multipliers) with intermediate values, floor result, and minimum cap.
nodes.languageNotes: Svelte 5 with $: reactive declaration for startCD

nodes.name: CritIcon.svelte
nodes.summary: Inline SVG crit icon component (~14 lines). Renders a star-shaped gradient SVG with configurable size.

nodes.name: DamageAnalyzer.svelte
nodes.summary: Comprehensive damage analysis component (~7385 lines). Computes full damage breakdown: weapon/M1/M2/weapon-art/rune/perk hit tables, DoT scaling, damage type resolution, defense/compliance calculations, buff/debuff/boost toggles, healing analysis, proc chance calculations, scaling breakdown rows, and stat efficiency analysis.
nodes.languageNotes: Svelte 5 reactive declarations; the largest file in the project

nodes.name: computeActiveDefensivePerkSources
nodes.summary: Resolves active defensive perk sources based on current build state and conditions.

nodes.name: getEffectiveDotScalings
nodes.summary: Returns effective DoT scaling values for a given DoT type, incorporating perk modifiers.

nodes.name: dotScalingMult
nodes.summary: Returns the total scaling multiplier for a given DoT type.

nodes.name: toggleBuffKey
nodes.summary: Toggles a buff/debuff by its composite key (buffName::sourceName).

nodes.name: toggleBuffByName
nodes.summary: Toggles all instances of a buff by name across all sources.

nodes.name: fmtSeq
nodes.summary: Formats a HitSeq (hit sequence) object into a human-readable string.

nodes.name: fmtNum
nodes.summary: Formats a number to 2 decimal places.

nodes.name: calcGroupMultiplier
nodes.summary: Calculates the compounded multiplier from a list of raw multiplier entries.

nodes.name: seqWithTypes
nodes.summary: Resolves damage type breakdown for a hit sequence, applying bonuses and resolve logic.

nodes.name: applyPiercerTrueConversion
nodes.summary: Converts a portion of damage types to True damage based on Piercer perk rank.

nodes.name: toggleBoost
nodes.summary: Toggles a named damage boost on/off in the disabled set.

nodes.name: toggleEffect
nodes.summary: Toggles a named combat effect on/off in the disabled set.

nodes.name: cycleLightningState
nodes.summary: Cycles Lightning Cloak state through off/thunder/bolt modes.

nodes.name: cycleStormRendState
nodes.summary: Cycles Storm Rend state through off/enchanted/empowered modes.

nodes.name: buildScalingRows
nodes.summary: Builds scaling breakdown rows from weapon scaling data for the detail view.

nodes.name: parseWAHitsAll
nodes.summary: Parses a weapon art's hit data from its baseDamage string into structured hit definitions.

nodes.name: cycleWildBoltElem
nodes.summary: Cycles Wild Bolt element through available element types.

nodes.name: parseRangeDamage
nodes.summary: Parses a range damage string like '15-25' into min/max values with labels.

nodes.name: applyWeaponCharge
nodes.summary: Applies weapon charge multipliers to a damage value based on active charge state.

nodes.name: _computePerkScalingMult
nodes.summary: Computes the effective scaling multiplier for a perk's damage definition from the build's stats.

nodes.name: DidYouMean.svelte
nodes.summary: Search suggestion component (~111 lines). Displays 'Did you mean?' suggestions when no exact search results are found, with highlighted text matching and dispatch events on selection.

nodes.name: highlightParts

nodes.languageNotes: Svelte 5 with createEventDispatcher for event delegation

nodes.name: handleSelect
nodes.summary: Forwards SuggestDrop select events to parent via dispatch.

nodes.summary: Forwards TagFilter clear event to parent via dispatch.

nodes.summary: Inline SVG mount icon component (~64 lines). Renders a detailed horse-like mount silhouette with configurable size and gradient fills.
nodes.languageNotes: Svelte 5, pure SVG component with embedded path data

nodes.summary: Updates the Propelling Fun element (air/fire) in the build store.

nodes.name: updateBuffMode
nodes.summary: Updates the Propelling Fun buff mode (air/fire/both) in the build store.

nodes.name: onElemSlider
nodes.summary: Event handler for the element slider input.

nodes.name: onBuffSlider
nodes.summary: Event handler for the buff mode slider input.
